item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya wants to make a small cell at home to light an LED, like the lemon cell she saw in class. She tries four different setups.

Setup 1: a copper strip and an iron nail pushed into a lemon, joined by wires to the LED.
Setup 2: two copper strips pushed into a lemon, joined by wires to the LED.
Setup 3: a copper strip and an iron nail placed in a dry plastic box, joined by wires to the LED.
Setup 4: two iron nails pushed into a lemon, joined by wires to the LED.

In which setup will the LED glow?

options.A: Setup 2, because two copper strips in a lemon always produce electricity
options.B: Setup 1, because it has two electrodes of different metals and the lemon juice acts as an electrolyte
options.C: Setup 4, because iron is a better conductor than copper
options.D: Setup 3, because keeping the electrodes dry makes the cell safer and stronger
